courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 次級離子質譜儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「飛行時間方程與質量尺度」與「質量校正與 ppm 誤差來源」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；次級離子質譜儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "The flight-time equation and the mass scale" and "Mass calibration and sources of ppm error" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Secondary-ion mass spectrometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦飛行時間方程、解析力、反射器能量聚焦、MCP 與 TDC 計時、質量校正與正交加速工作週期；次級離子質譜儀則以濺射與離子化機率、有用產率、質量解析、相對靈敏度因子與深度剖析的痕量分析工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on flight-time equation, resolving power, reflectron energy focusing, MCP and TDC timing, mass calibration and orthogonal-acceleration duty cycle; Secondary-ion mass spectrometers centres on sputtering and ionisation probability, useful yield, mass resolution, relative sensitivity factors and depth-profiling engineering for trace analysis, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「加速區與無場漂移管」與「碰撞級聯與二次離子」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到次級離子質譜儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「計數統計、背景與偵測極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Acceleration region and field-free drift tube” and “Collision cascade and secondary ions”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Secondary-ion mass spectrometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Counting statistics, background and detection limits", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 飛行時間質譜儀
history.text: 1946 年賓州大學的 William Stephens 提出飛行時間質量分析的構想，1955 年 Bendix 公司的 Wiley 與 McLaren 發表雙段加速的空間聚焦與時間延遲聚焦，奠定商用儀器的基礎。1973 年 Mamyrin 在列寧格勒提出反射器，大幅提升解析力；1980 年代後期 Karas 與 Hillenkamp 以及島津製作所的田中耕一發展出基質輔助雷射脫附游離（MALDI），田中與電灑游離的 John Fenn 共同獲得 2002 年諾貝爾化學獎；正交加速讓連續的電灑離子源也能接上飛行時間分析器，今日的四極—飛行時間與多次反射式儀器已是蛋白質體與代謝體研究的主力。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1946 William Stephens of the University of Pennsylvania proposed time-of-flight mass analysis, and in 1955 Wiley and McLaren of the Bendix Corporation published two-stage space focusing and time-lag focusing, the basis of commercial instruments. In 1973 Mamyrin in Leningrad proposed the reflectron, greatly raising resolving power; in the late 1980s Karas and Hillenkamp, and Koichi Tanaka at Shimadzu, developed matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionisation (MALDI), and Tanaka shared the 2002 Nobel Prize in Chemistry with John Fenn of electrospray ionisation; orthogonal acceleration let continuous electrospray sources feed time-of-flight analysers, and today quadrupole–time-of-flight and multi-reflecting instruments are workhorses of proteomics and metabolomics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「飛行時間方程與質量尺度」到「儀器驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "The flight-time equation and the mass scale" through "Instrument acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
